claim_boundary: This artifact records exactness and pass/fail standards for future fixture attempts. It does not satisfy those standards or close any gate.
exact_enough_requirements: exact switch values are written symbolically
reduced action or reduced field equations are shown after substitution
every surviving term has defined dimensions and SI-unit interpretation
every dropped term is identically zero or disabled under the stated switch
boundary, frame, gauge, coordinate, and sign conventions are named
comparator theory or reference state is named exactly
if asymptotic, order of limits is specified and non-commuting limits are addressed
expected recovery behavior is declared before any run

pass_fail_labels.label: not_run
pass_fail_labels.meaning: fixture is designed or held but not executed

pass_fail_labels.label: ready_to_attempt
pass_fail_labels.meaning: all required inputs are present, but no comparison result exists

pass_fail_labels.label: pass_for_fixture_only
pass_fail_labels.meaning: exact comparison succeeds inside the declared fixture and scope
pass_fail_labels.allowed_claim: fixture-local hygiene only, not GMUT validation

pass_fail_labels.label: fail_for_fixture
pass_fail_labels.meaning: residual term, mismatch, unit issue, exchange issue, or force-response issue contradicts expected behavior

required_checks_before_any_pass_label: consciousness bridge status explicitly blocked or scoped
overclaim_guard: terms marked held are not disabled and cannot support gate closure
suppressed or phenomenologically negligible contributions are context only
full scalar disablement bypasses unresolved scalar physics and does not validate the scalar route
coupling-to-zero is an interaction diagnostic and does not prove baseline recovery
all six gates remain open unless exact closure artifacts exist
